unit_policy: Preserve native coordinates for reconstruction. Apply final scale only after shape validation.

principal_axes.note: Diagnostic only; original STL Z axis already behaves like a plausible vertical axis.

recommended_first_pass: Import STL as locked reference mesh
Recreate section polylines from this package
Fit each significant loop with degree-3 NURBS using tolerance based on native bbox diagonal
Use section families to identify coherent surface regions; do not loft across topology changes
Rebuild only the dominant component first; treat component 1 as separate detail
Compare rebuilt surfaces to reference mesh using point-to-mesh deviation before joining
